faqs.question: What is the difference between beard oil and this Minoxidil beard growth serum? Why is this the best alternative to beard growth oil?
faqs.answer: Minoxidil is clinically proven to activate dormant hair follicles for improving growth and filling patches. Beard growth oil does not do this, and tends to be heavier on beard, making it look shiny and sometimes greasy. Thus, they aren't comparable. This Minoxidil solution for beard growth is lightweight in nature making it ideal for all-day use!

faqs.question: Does BeardMax 5% Minoxidil Beard Growth Serum initially cause shedding of beard?
faqs.answer: The Minoxidil 5% solution for men may initially lead to some shedding but it's part of the treatment. The treatment synchronizes the beard growth cycle which results in the phasing out of extremely weak hair, thus the shedding.

faqs.question: Can I apply this Minoxidil for beard solution on my face after derma rolling? Do I need to wait 8-24 hours?
faqs.answer: You can apply the Minoxidil 5% solution right after dermarolling. It's advised to use a roller with 0.5mm needles.

faqs.question: Does this Minoxidil 5% solution for men have any side effects?
faqs.answer: This Minoxidil 5% solution is an alcohol-free formula, which means you won't experience blemish, itching or irritation. Regular use of minoxidil may cause dryness of the skin or facial hair, but this varies. A face moisturiser can be applied after a gap of 2 hours from applying the serum.

faqs.question: Is this Minoxidil 5% beard serum water-based?
faqs.answer: Yes, this Minoxidil 5% for men is a water-based solution. This makes it light and non-sticky. You'll barely notice it once you have it on.

faqs.question: Should I wash my face after applying this Minoxidil 5% for beard growth solution?
faqs.answer: This is a water-based solution which seeps into your beard and doesn't leave any residue behind. Minoxidil 5% solution works on your beard without looking greasy. You won't have to wash your face after applying it. Thus, you can continue following your existing cleansing regimen.

faqs.question: Does it make the beard oily or greasy if applied to wet hair?
faqs.answer: Minoxidil 5% solution is oil-free so, it will not make your beard and skin greasy. Applying it onto skin that's damp is recommended with this solution, for improved efficacy.

faqs.question: How often should I use this beard serum?
faqs.answer: We'd recommend that it be applied daily, for 6 months. The serum is designed to be used every day.

faqs.question: I have started to notice that the colour of the Minoxidil 5% Solution is changing. Does it mean this has spoilt?
faqs.answer: This Minoxidil 5% solution may change colour over time. However, it doesn't impact product efficacy or quality.

faqs.question: Does shaving increase beard growth?
faqs.answer: No, this is a common myth that is not grounded in reality. Shaving doesn't have any tangible impact on improving beard density. Excessive shaving can even be irritating for the skin, slowing down beard development.
